sources.title: NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls ECC 2:2024, English
sources.locator: Scope of Work and Applicability; numbered ECC controls

limitations: Curated partial clause coverage only. The baseline is an assessment target, never a national security grade or a certification decision.
Sector controls, CCC/DCC/CSCC and entity-specific applicability are additional review work. Selected English controls were checked; no full ECC or Arabic legal interpretation claimed.
